pages.lesson:
LESSON: ENVIRONMENT 6.3.1 CARE FOR DOMESTIC ANIMALS

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Care for domestic animals in their environment according to the values of Islam.
2. Appreciate the domestic animals as part of creations of 146 Allah. animals?

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Care for domestic animals in their environment according to the values of Islam.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to care for domestic animals in their environment according to the values of Islam. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate the domestic animals as part of creations of 146 Allah. animals?
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the domestic animals as part of creations of 146 Allah. animals?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.
2. Explain Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.
4. Show that you can: Care for domestic animals in their environment according to the values of Islam.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Care for domestic animals in their environment according to the values of Islam.
2. Appreciate the domestic animals as part of creations of 146 Allah. animals?

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
